description: Kickoff: a football next-match tracker for web, iPhone and Mac.

color.name: seed
color.usage: The dot after a team you follow. The same saffron as accent: one saffron moment per row.

color.name: ring-track
color.usage: The unfilled part of the ring.

color.name: ring-far
color.usage: Ring when kickoff is more than a day away.

color.name: ring-soon
color.usage: Ring when kickoff is inside a day.

color.name: ring-near
color.usage: Ring when kickoff is inside three hours.

color.name: ring-live
color.usage: Ring while the match is in play.

color.name: seed-edge
color.usage: The darker gold edge around the seed, so the dot still shows on light surfaces (3:1 or better).

size.name: crest-sm
size.usage: Crest in dense lists and the Mac menu window.

size.name: ring-hero
size.usage: The ring in the next-match panel.

size.name: ring-menubar
size.usage: The ring as the Mac menu bar icon.

size.name: ring-stroke
size.usage: Ring stroke inside a 100 unit box; scale with the ring.
